description: Issue #147: the derivation is per ECOSYSTEM, not per JS. FILE_EXT accepts go|py|java|kt|rb, so a JS-only rule would leave exactly those issues with the failure this feature removes. A Go file gets `_test.go` and nothing else — `go test` only recognises that name, in the same package directory, so there is no second shape to guess. A Python file gets pytest's `test_*.py` both beside the module and under a top-level `tests/`, because both layouts are ubiquitous and neither is derivable from the other. Crucially, neither path gets the JS shapes: `internal/store/session.test.go` and `app/loader.spec.py` must NOT appear.
